items.prompt: What does the writer say about the graduate programme?

options.text: Interns may apply for it once their placement ends
Fifteen places on it are shared out across the departments
Invitations to apply are tied to what the business needs
It is likely to start within weeks of the internship finishing

items.evidence: Interns complete a short performance review at the five-week mark and a final review before departure; strong performers may be invited to apply for the graduate programme the following year, though this is not guaranteed and depends on business need.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- basvuru daveti yalniz guclu performans gosteren stajyerlere taniniyor ve ertesi yil icin geciyor (A metni D/2); secenek olculu yazilmis olsa da hakki butun stajyerlere ve stajin bitisine tasiyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Yer degistirme -- on bes kisilik kontenjan staj programina ait (A metni C/2); secenek bu sayiyi mezun programina yukluyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Yakin ama eksik -- metin davetin ertesi yil icin oldugunu soyluyor; stajin bitisinden birkac hafta sonra baslayan bir programdan soz edilmiyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph D of Text A says that strong performers may be invited to apply for the graduate programme the following year, though this is not guaranteed and depends on business need.
items.flag_reason: Secenek C'deki 'depends partly on' (kismen bagli) olculu ifadesi, metnin kendi hedge'iyle ('not guaranteed... depends on business need') ortusuyor; A'daki 'any intern' (herhangi bir stajyer) mutlak genellemesi ise metnin 'guclu performans gosterenler' sinirlamasiyla celisiyor -- bu kesinlik farki parcaya bakmadan da C'yi isaret ediyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: What does the writer say about the graduate programme?

onceki_secenekler.A: Any intern can apply for it after the placement
onceki_secenekler.B: It takes on fifteen graduates across the departments
onceki_secenekler.C: An invitation to apply depends partly on company needs
onceki_secenekler.D: It begins soon after the internship comes to an end

revision.ne_degisti: Kip ters yone cevrildi: dogru secenek C'nin olculu ifadesi ('depends partly on') kesin bicime getirildi ('are tied to what the business needs'), buna karsilik A ve D olculu kipe cekildi ('any intern can' -> 'interns may', 'begins soon after' -> 'is likely to start'). Artik olculu yazilan iki secenek de yanlis, kesin yazilan iki secenegin biri dogru; 'olculu = dogru' imzasi kalkti.

items.prompt: What does the writer say about staff who deal directly with clients?

options.text: They can be asked to come in on more days than others
They are not allowed to work remotely at all
They might also need written approval from the HR team
They receive a larger equipment allowance than other staff

items.evidence: Staff in client-facing roles may be required to attend the office more frequently regardless of general policy.

distractor_analysis.B: Kapsam kaydirma -- metin bu rollerin ofise daha sik cagrilabilecegini soyluyor (B metni A/2); secenek bunu tam bir uzaktan calisma yasagina buyutuyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Yer degistirme -- hem IK'dan hem ilgili ulke ofisinden yazili onay sarti yurt disindan calismak icin gecerli (B metni D/2); musteriyle calisan roller icin degil.
distractor_analysis.D: Yakin ama eksik -- ev ofisi ekipmani icin yillik 150 sterlinlik geri odeme butun uzaktan calisanlar icin ayni (B metni B/4); bu gruba ek bir odenek taninmiyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph A of Text B says that staff in client-facing roles may be required to attend the office more frequently, regardless of the general policy on remote days.

revision.onceki_prompt: What does the writer say about staff who deal directly with clients?

onceki_secenekler.A: They may need to spend more days in the office
onceki_secenekler.B: They are not allowed to work remotely at all
onceki_secenekler.C: They need approval from HR as well as a manager
onceki_secenekler.D: They are given extra money for home equipment

revision.ne_degisti: Dogru secenek A metnin kendi 'may be required' kalibini birebir yankilamayacak bicimde yeniden yazildi ('may need to spend' -> 'can be asked to come in'), celdiricilerden C olculu kipe cekildi ('need approval' -> 'might also need'), D ise kesin bicimde birakildi. Yeni dagilim: olculu 2 secenegin 1'i dogru, kesin 2 secenegin 0'i dogru. GT2 setinin tamami icinde (21 ve 22 birlikte) olculu 4 secenegin 1'i, kesin 4 secenegin 1'i dogru -- set duzeyinde kip dengelenmis oldu.

items.prompt: Which TWO statements about the remote working policy are correct?

options.text: Staff may work remotely as soon as they join the company
Remote working arrangements are all reviewed every six months
The company pays for the internet connection used at home
Employees may work from abroad if their manager agrees
Home-office claims usually go through the line manager
Everyone must spend at least one day a week in the office
Any change to someone's remote days needs a week's notice

items.evidence: Remote working arrangements are reviewed every six months and may be withdrawn if performance or availability standards are not met. Requests to change remote working days must be submitted at least one week in advance.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- uzaktan calisma basvurusu deneme suresini tamamlamis calisanlara acik (A/1); ise baslar baslamaz degil.
distractor_analysis.C: Ters yon -- en az 10 Mbps'lik baglantiyi calisanin kendisi saglamak zorunda (B/2); sirketin verdigi sey dizustu bilgisayar.
distractor_analysis.D: Kapsam kaydirma -- yurt disindan calismak icin hem IK'dan hem ilgili ulke ofisinden ayri yazili onay gerekiyor (D/2); amir onayi tek basina yetmiyor.
distractor_analysis.E: Yer degistirme -- onayli ev ofisi ekipmani icin geri odeme masraf sistemi uzerinden isteniyor (B/5), amir uzerinden degil.
distractor_analysis.F: Cazip ama yok -- haftada bir gun ofiste bulunma zorunlulugu metinde yok; yalniz musteriyle calisan rollerin daha sik cagrilabilecegi soyleniyor (A/2).

items.explanation: Paragraph C of Text B says remote working arrangements are reviewed every six months, and that requests to change remote working days must be submitted at least one week in advance.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Which TWO things must remote employees do?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Be available on instant messaging during core hours. Employees must designate a single working location for remote days and notify the HR team in advance if that location changes for more than two consecutive weeks, for insurance and tax purposes.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sorunun ekseni uzaktan calisma politikalarinin standart maddeleri: cekirdek saatlerde ulasilabilir olmak (B) ve kalici konum degisikligini IK'ya bildirmek (D) bu tur politikalarda neredeyse her zaman bulunur. Secenek dengelemesi bu ekseni degistirmez.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva bosaltilip ayni metinden yeni bir soruyla dolduruldu. Eski soru B paragrafinin ucuncu maddesi ile D/1'e dayaniyordu: cekirdek saatlerde ulasilabilir olmak ve kalici konum degisikligini IK'ya bildirmek. Uzaktan calisma politikalarinin neredeyse hepsinde bulunan iki madde oldugu icin B+D ikilisi metne bakilmadan seciliyordu. Yeni soru o iki cumleye hic degmiyor: kanit C/2 ve C/3'e tasindi. Kurgu GT1'deki ile ayni: en tanidik uc madde (deneme suresi olmadan uzaktan calisma, internetin sirketce odenmesi, amir onayiyla yurt disi) celdirici yapildi; dogru iki secenek sirkete ozgu iki keyfi sureye baglandi (alti aylik gozden gecirme, bir haftalik bildirim). Konumsal duzen icin harf cifti B+G; boylece bu calistirmadaki bes iki-harfli yuvada A, B, C, D, E, F, G harflerinin hepsi en az bir kez dogru oluyor ve hicbir cift tekrarlanmiyor.
